evals.name: pptx-with-declared-theme
evals.prompt: The client sent over their master PowerPoint template — it's at ~/brand/AcmeCorp_Master_2024.pptx. I need to get their design system out of it so we can build decks in their style. Can you set that up?
evals.expected_output: A pack directory with design-system.json, tailwind.config.js, slide-base.html, templates/, off-brand-fixture.html and PROVENANCE.md. Theme colours read from theme1.xml and marked 'declared' in provenance. verify_pack.py run, with templates passing and the fixture failing.

evals.name: pdf-guidelines-thin-source
evals.prompt: here's northwind's brand guidelines pdf (Northwind_Brand_2025.pdf, 6 pages, mostly logo usage). need a design system pack for the deck pipeline out of it
evals.expected_output: Probes the PDF, states plainly that a 6-page logo-usage PDF yields a partial system, names what could not be determined (type ramp, muted, viz order), and either forges a partial pack with the gaps marked in PROVENANCE.md or asks for a better source. Must NOT pad missing tokens with plausible defaults.

evals.name: inaccessible-muted
evals.prompt: Build a design system pack from ~/brand/nordvik-deck.pptx. Their brand grey is #9A9A9A — that's the one they use for all the small caption text.
evals.expected_output: Notices #9A9A9A is roughly 2.8:1 on white and fails AA for body text. Does not silently ship it as `muted`. Either darkens it for the muted role and records the derivation and the ratio, or keeps it as muted-soft for decorative use only — and says which, with numbers.

evals.name: not-a-forge-task
evals.prompt: We already have the Acme pack set up. Can you make me a 10-slide capability deck for the Northwind data platform work?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT forge a pack. Recognises this as deck production against an existing pack and routes to a deck orchestrator instead.

evals.name: amend-inaccessible-token
evals.prompt: The muted grey in our existing design system pack at ~/packs/northwind/ is #9A9A9A and someone flagged it fails contrast on captions. Can you fix it across the pack?
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as amending an existing pack, not forging a new one. Runs verify_pack.py / audit_pack.py for a baseline first. States the contrast ratio and the darkened value with numbers, changes design-system.json + tailwind.config.js + slide-base.html first, then greps for and updates every template/chart/snippet that hardcodes the old hex — not just the config. Re-runs audit_pack.py and verify_pack.py afterward and reports both results. Updates PROVENANCE.md and bumps version.

evals.name: audit-existing-pack-drift
evals.prompt: Can you check whether the templates in ~/packs/acme/ still match tailwind.config.js? I think someone hand-edited one of the slides and I'm not sure what else might be out of sync.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/audit_pack.py against the pack rather than re-forging or eyeballing individual files. Reports token collisions, config drift between templates and the canonical tailwind.config.js, undersized raw font sizes, and any off-token hex colours as PROBLEM vs warning per the script's output — not a generic 'looks fine' without running the tool.
